meta.title: Rahul's six-month backend + After Effects roadmap
meta.description: 26 weeks of Java, Spring, databases, security, cloud and Databricks with system design woven in, plus 24 weeks of After Effects and a daily DSA habit.

good: Every task done yesterday. That's how six months actually gets finished.
Full marks for yesterday. Do it again today.
Yesterday was a complete day. Stack another one on top.
ok: Half done is better than zero, but don't let 'half' become the habit.
Some progress yesterday. Today, finish the list.
Decent, not great. You know which task you dodged. Start with that one.
bad: Yesterday was close to zero. The roadmap doesn't move on its own, {name}.
You skipped yesterday. No excuses today: open the first task now.
Zero-ish day. One bad day is noise, two is a pattern. Don't make it two.
start: Day one. Two hours today, that's all. Go.
New day, clean slate. First task, right now.
dayDone: Every task done today. Proper work.
Today's list is cleared. That's a win.
nudgeHard: Close the laptop on a zero day? Not today.
Twenty minutes now beats a perfect plan tomorrow.
boost: You're building something most people only talk about. Keep going.
Consistency beats intensity. Show up today.
scold: You said you wanted someone on your back. This is it. Go.
praise: Proud of that one. Keep the streak alive.
